claim_scope: Train-only diagnostic evidence about gradient sampling, detached rollout graphs, clipping, objective alignment, and a finite oracle line-search grid. It cannot authorize promotion, establish validation/test_id accuracy, or establish the Target-5 claim.
hypothesis: The r3 accuracy floor can be localized by comparing the exact complete-future full-BPTT gradient with the algebraically equivalent same-graph Horvitz-Thompson gradient and the existing detached training-window estimator on a non-performance-selected, one-per-family train/fit panel.
expected_mechanism: Layer A measures the exact 399-future-frame rollout gradient. Layer B isolates HT algebra on that same rollout graph. Layer C adds the actual detached pushforward and warm-start behavior used during r3 training. Their gradient angles, sampling variance, clipping incidence, and reversible line-search response distinguish sampling, rollout-graph/TBPTT, auxiliary-target, clipping, optimization, and local-plateau explanations.
primary_metric: Cosine and relative norm difference between the four-record equal-weight aggregate existing training-window HT gradient and the exact full-rollout BPTT gradient, with preregistered classification thresholds and reversible train-only line-search checks.

data.selection_rule: Within each family, select the r3 role=fit record with minimum (source_index, sample_id), independent of all performance values.
data.selection_digest_correction_note: The initial data-audit digest b365de4d94f3526570c312e143f791887404834d5b58d545284c37a3622da2f7 was computed from a six-field projection that omitted cache_position. Recalculation established e22704d9c8627b03572945a6aeee7ddfb3d0ebd6de60ee7a923f75ba85ce5464 as the authoritative digest of the complete seven-field records. Both are retained, with the six-field value explicitly non-authoritative, to preserve audit provenance.
data.future_truth_access: Only exact future truth for the four selected train/fit records is permitted. Smoke reads only the first selected train/fit record. No validation or test_id future wavefield may be opened.

model.gradient_flatten_order: model.named_parameters() declaration order, filtered by requires_grad=True
model.none_gradient_policy: Any None gradient is unexpected and makes the audit invalid. No missing gradient is silently accepted, although the implementation would otherwise represent it as zero.

diagnostic.layer_a: One complete model.rollout with full-main objective and full BPTT over all 399 future frames.
diagnostic.layer_b: On the exact Layer-A rollout graph, enumerate all 13 registered windows and average their HT main objectives.
diagnostic.layer_c: For each registered start, call the unchanged training_window with one detached pushforward warm-start when start>2 and up to two supervised free-running blocks; average all 13 HT gradients.
diagnostic.spectral_estimator_scope: The local spectral estimator is exactly the existing record_energy_squared_loss implementation. It is not an unbiased estimator of the full-trajectory spectral objective.
diagnostic.aggregation: All 13 starts are averaged equally within each record. All four selected records are averaged equally for run aggregates; no family or energy reweighting is permitted.
diagnostic.sampling_cv_formula: sqrt(mean_s ||g_s-gbar||^2) / max(||gbar||,1e-12), using Layer-C HT-total gradients
diagnostic.window_to_own_ht_cosine: Each Layer-C HT-total window gradient versus that record's 13-start mean HT-total gradient.

clip_diagnostic.rule: Report count, fraction, norm p50, norm p95, norm max, and implied clipping scales for all 52 run windows. Do not actually clip gradients.

algebra_and_integrity_gates.rollback: Before every line-search point and after it, restore and torch.equal-verify every parameter, buffer, existing gradient, CPU RNG state, and all CUDA RNG states. Repeat at terminal state.

line_search.evaluation: Four selected records, equal weight. Report exact full main, full composite, and per-record full main at every point.
prohibitions: No optimizer.step or training update may occur.
No parameterized point or model state may be saved.

classification.invalid: Any binding, role, group, start, shape, finite, inclusion, HT algebra, repeatability, or rollback gate failure.
classification.target_or_auxiliary_mismatch: cos(full_total,full_main)<0.80 OR (training-window-total direction oracle main improvement<0.001 AND full-main direction oracle main improvement>=0.01).
classification.sampling_limited: At least 3 of 4 per-record Layer-C HT-total sampling CV values are >1.0 OR the median across all 52 window-to-own-HT-total cosines is <0.50.
classification.tbptt_or_rollout_graph_limited: cos(aggregate training-window-HT-main,aggregate full-main)<0.80 OR the median of the four per-record corresponding cosines is <0.70.
classification.clip_limited: The fraction of the 52 Layer-C HT-total window gradient norms strictly >1.0 is >=0.25.
classification.optimization_limited_supported: Only if no preceding mismatch/limited flag is true, the training-window-total direction produces full-main improvement>=0.01, full composite relative change<=1e-8, and maximum per-record main regression<=0.01.
classification.local_plateau_architecture_or_target_can: The best full-main direction full-main improvement over the entire registered rho grid is <0.001.

failure_signal: Stop and classify invalid on any hash/path/schema/split/role/group/selection/start/shape/finite/inclusion/HT-algebra/repeatability/rollback drift, any unexpected None gradient, wall or memory budget violation, any input mutation, or any attempt to open validation/test_id. Preserve a failure-only atomic JSON report containing no model weights.

rollback.policy: The audit is read-only except for its JSON report. Never write a checkpoint or retain a line-search parameter state. Preserve all A3, B2-H, Helmholtz, ASAM, CPADC, r2, and r3 checkpoints.

determinism_requirements: CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 must be present before process start
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 must be present before process start
No concurrent writer or GPU workload
